name: Selective copper collector
problem: Copper flotation loses 10-15% of copper to tailings and drags pyrite into the concentrate
design: Flotation collector that grabs copper sulfides and rejects pyrite

market.what: thiol collectors for sulfide ores (xanthates, dithiophosphates, thionocarbamates, MBT, phosphines), world; copper is the largest slice
market.method: xanthate ~372 kt x ~$1.7/kg = $0.63B + other thiols est. ~$0.5B; check: reports put collectors at 36% of $3.4-5.8B reagents = $1.2-2.1B; copper slice bottom-up 3.3 Bt ore x ~35 g/t (est.) x $2.5/kg = ~$0.3B

value.logic: 18.4 Mt Cu in concentrate at ~87% recovery; +1 pt recovery = +0.21 Mt Cu x ~$12.5k/t net (LME ~$14.4k less TC/RC, payables) = $2.6B; less pyrite = higher conc grade, ~3% less conc freight est. $0.1B
value.revenue_logic: 3-5 concentrators, ~150 Mt ore/yr (~4.5% of world Cu ore) x 20 g/t = 3 kt x $8/kg premium price; ~17% of the mines' +1 pt value
value.margin_logic: 1-2 step thiocarbamate type, toll-made at ~$3-4/kg est.; priced as specialty vs $1.5-2.4/kg xanthate

trend.drivers: S&P: Cu demand 28 Mt (2025) to 42 Mt (2040), AI data centers + grid + EVs; IEA 30% mined-supply gap by 2035; concentrator grades down 1.22% to 0.69% since 2002; xanthate CS2 hazard pressure (AU, water quality)

incumbents: Qixia Tongda / Tieling / Qingdao xanthate makers
competition.notes: Syensqo strongest (Aerophine, SmartFloat AI dosing); Giraffe Bio $6.4M seed Oct 2026 (BHP Ventures), claims up to +5% Cu vs 1-2% norm; no startup found designing new synthetic collector molecules; Chinese xanthate sets price floor

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: thionocarbamate / dithiophosphinate from isothiocyanate or chlorophosphine + alcohol/amine; 3 variants, 20-50 g each
lab.test: Hallimond tube microflotation on pure chalcopyrite vs pyrite (zeta/contact angle); then Denver-cell batch rougher+cleaner tests on a real porphyry ore with Cu/Fe/S assays vs SIBX/IPETC; ALS, SGS, Base Met Labs or a university lab
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + microflotation 3 wk + batch floats 6 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + microflotation ~$8k + ~25 batch tests x ~$1.2k with assays (est.) + mineralogy ~$4k

sale.gates: mine ore lab program 3-6 mo; plant on/off trial 1-3 mo after baseline (small gains need stats); reagent safety/SDS and tailings water check; then supply contract, often via a reagent distributor
